MODULE DOCUMENTATION (excerpt):
Stock Picking Invoice Link

Adds link between pickings and invoices

## DESCRIPTION
The base module used by sale_stock_picking_invoice_link and purchase_stock_picking_invoice_link 
to adds a link between pickings and invoices as well as on the lines.

## USAGE
- Create a Sales Order and confirm.
- Deliver its pickings totally or partially.
- Create an invoice of the goods delivered.
- If you open invoice form, you must see a new Pickings tab with
  information about them.

selected.reason: When a partial delivery creates a backorder, invoices created for delivered quantities can incorrectly link to the backorder picking.
Removing an invoice line manually does not un-link the corresponding stock picking from the invoice.
Return pickings and invoices with negative quantities are not properly reflected or linked in the picking list.
When multiple partial invoices are created for a single stock picking, the picking fails to display all associated invoices.
Business requirement to print stock picking references and delivery dates on customer invoice documents for regulatory compliance.
